question: Rakshabandhan, a festival celebrating the bond between brother and sister, was celebrated in the month of ________ in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**August.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• **Rakshabandhan** **is celebrated on the full moon day of the Hindu month of Shravana, which usually falls in August.**
 
• It is a Hindu festival that **celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters.**
